goal: Electro-optic 2x2 MZI in Luxtelligence lnoi400 with balanced routes, superseding the passive OPA-LAYOUT-004

vpi.note: OPA-EO-002 modelled a 600 nm film with a 300 nm etch and a 1.2 um rib; lnoi400 has its own stack and a 2.5 um modulator rib, so the two numbers are not the same device

optical_ports_connected.detail: 32 optical instance ports checked in every cell (ignoring the MZI's marker ports ['upper_taper_start', 'short_bias_branch_start', 'long_bias_branch_start']); problems: none

inside_chip_frame.detail: LN outside the frame 0.000 um2; non-edge-coupler LN in the exclusion zone 0.000 um2; metal outside the contour 0.000 um2

electrodes.detail: 3 GSG conductors (TL), 1 heater (HT), shared metal 0.000 um2, electrical ports ['heater_1', 'heater_2', 'rf_in', 'rf_out'], RF pads on TL: True

vpi_from_pdk_model.detail: push-pull V_pi = 6.60 V from the PDK's sax model (transmission 0.933 -> 6.10e-24); formula 6.60 V, i.e. V_pi*L = 3.3 V cm

gds_reproducible.detail: a fresh Python process regenerates a byte-identical GDS file

limitations: Not checked against the lnoi400 DRC; Luxtelligence distributes the runset on request
No RF design: impedance, velocity matching and termination are the PDK defaults and have not been simulated
V_pi is the PDK's compact model, not a measurement or a simulation of this chip
Only theta is tunable (Pockels and thermal bias); no phi, a or b phase shifters
No optical simulation of the chip
